title: Seven unreferenced Network kit placeholder PNGs (7.5 MB) stop shipping in public

source.ref: Rescan 2026-11-02 (audits/rescan-2026-11-02.md); owner phrase 2026-11-02 retired the LIVE-1671 placeholder pin

verify.note: Fails before the change: the seven placeholder-0N.png files exist.

detail: public/sites/network-kit/photos carried placeholder-01..07.png (0.7 to 1.5 MB each, 7.5 MB). Nothing in lib, components, app or scripts references them (the Designer kit's placeholder-0N keys resolve to dz-*.webp through lib/themes/designer-kits.json). LIVE-1671's probe pinned them byte for byte; the owner retired that pin in his own words on 2026-11-02, and the probe now pins the twelve photos only.
